title: A write-up generator
description:
Turn your notes into a tidy report in Markdown.

```
# Analysis of savegame.dat
## Summary
The file is a header and fixed records...
## Findings
1. Magic "XS" at offset 0 (confidence: high)
2. Checksum is a byte sum (confidence: medium, tested on 3 samples)
## Open questions
- What byte 9 means
```
hints: Saying how sure you are, and why, is what makes a write-up useful to someone else (lesson 6.04).
`std::sort` with a lambda on `offset` orders the findings.
requirements: Findings have a title, an offset, a confidence and evidence.
Sort them by offset; group the open questions at the end.
Output Markdown with headings and a numbered list.
stretch: Also write the findings as a table with columns.
